roads.what: The social and video surfaces where creator campaigns are posted and seen
roads.basis: industry structure (influencer campaigns run on the social/video platforms where creators and audiences are)

roads.what: Card rails that bill brands and route commissions and payouts to creators
roads.basis: industry structure (campaign billing and affiliate payouts flow through card processors on the networks)

roads.what: Lithography machines
roads.basis: company filings: ASML sells to TSMC, Samsung, Intel

roads.what: Manufactured AI chips
roads.basis: TSMC fabricates chips for NVIDIA, Broadcom and the hyperscalers (Tom's Hardware, May 2026)

roads.what: HBM stacks mounted beside the processor
roads.basis: SK Hynix, Micron and Samsung supply HBM to NVIDIA and other AI-chip makers (Counterpoint, 2026)

roads.what: Logic base die for HBM4
roads.basis: SK Hynix uses TSMC to fabricate the HBM4 base die (2026 reports)

roads.what: GPUs and custom accelerators
roads.basis: company filings

roads.what: Rented compute
roads.basis: company filings and disclosed deals (Anthropic–AWS, OpenAI–Azure/CoreWeave)

roads.what: Payment rails for the cards banks issue
roads.basis: industry structure (issuing banks pay network fees)

roads.what: Electricity for data centers
roads.basis: utilities report multi-GW contracted large-load/data-center agreements (Reuters, May 2026)

roads.what: Electricity to run the fabs
roads.basis: industry structure (chip fabrication is highly power-intensive)

roads.what: Bare logic dies and silicon interposers to be packaged
roads.basis: industry structure (foundries fabricate wafers, then dies go to assembly and packaging)

roads.what: Advanced packaging (CoWoS): HBM bonded beside the logic die on an interposer
roads.basis: TSMC's CoWoS capacity is the widely reported bottleneck on NVIDIA AI-chip supply (2026 reports)

roads.what: Compute and hosting to run the platforms
roads.basis: industry structure (GitHub, GitLab and peers run their services on cloud infrastructure)

roads.what: Frontier models behind AI coding assistants
roads.basis: GitHub Copilot and Cursor build on OpenAI/Anthropic frontier models (2025–2026 coverage)

roads.what: Compute, storage and CDN bandwidth to stream video to billions
roads.basis: industry structure (video platforms run on cloud infrastructure and content delivery networks)

roads.what: Ad inventory and audience attention that the ad market sells to brands
roads.basis: ad-supported video platforms earn most of their revenue from advertising (eMarketer)

roads.what: Hosting, storage and delivery for creator sites, newsletters and gated media
roads.basis: industry structure (membership and newsletter platforms run on cloud infrastructure)

roads.what: Card rails that process fans' recurring subscription payments
roads.basis: industry structure (fan subscriptions are charged to cards via processors on the card networks)

roads.what: Hosting, storage and video delivery for course catalogs and live communities
roads.basis: industry structure (course and community platforms run on cloud infrastructure and video delivery)

roads.what: Ad reach to acquire learners and promote courses and communities
roads.basis: course marketplaces and creators are heavy buyers of digital advertising to drive enrollments (industry structure)
